subject: CONTROL clause
notes: kb/Work PB205. Uniqueness is of the WRITTEN reference (ReportControlRef.SameOperandAs over name + qualifiers + ref-mod), which is what SR6's own second sentence forces: two operands may 'refer to the same physical data item or to overlapping data items', so the referenced item cannot be what distinguishes them - and 13.18.57.3 SR10 could not name a level unambiguously if it were. The positive golden is the legal shape the second sentence permits (CONTROLS ARE CX(1:3) CX(4:)); the negative is the same reference twice. retired-witness: src/WiseOwl.Cobol.Compiler/Binding/DataBinder.Reports.cs#BindReportDescriptionClauses (kb/Work PB2357 split DataBinder.Reports.cs: the same code, unchanged, now lives in ReportSectionBinder.cs (the binder), ReportModel.cs (the model types) and ReportScope.cs (the visible-report lookups))
